verified_major_claims.claim: Accessible ramps require minimum clear width of 1200 mm.

Accessible ramp general gradient is not steeper than 1:20; steeper gradients may be allowed only in special cases depending on length. Table A.1.1 includes a 1:15 row with 10.50 m maximum length, 700 mm maximum rise, and 10 m landing interval.
verified_major_claims.source_locator: Appendix A, Accessible Ramps, item 2 and Table A.1.1
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: Gradient not steeper than 1:20... Steeper gradients may be allowed in special cases... 1:15 / 10.50m / 700mm / 10m.

verified_major_claims.claim: Accessible ramps with total length longer than 10.50 m require intermediate landings at least 1800 mm long; upper and lower level areas must be at least 1800 mm.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: Accessible ramps with a total length longer than 10.50m shall be provided with intermediate landings with a minimum length of 1800 mm... Level area not less than 1800 mm at the upper end and lower end of any ramp.

verified_major_claims.claim: Handrails are required for accessible ramps for changes in grade higher than 170 mm and installed at 900 mm and 700 mm.
